Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S27 A private reminder is never listed as a diagnosis in the generated note or the handoff (both modes)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U10 Never invent (3.4): no generated note or handoff lists an Important Point as a diagnosis or a finding ('no supplied diagnoses'). Whether points may appear in the note or handoff at all is Q8. (UAT 3.4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U7 Every step is repeated in Nursing Home and must pass in both modes. (UAT TC-12; UAT 3.3; TFA-92590 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident, each with the point 'QA-PRIVATE call dtr re SNF bed'

When Type an encounter that does not mention the point into the encounter box, Save & Extract, Generate AI Note and wait for the note; open the Handoff for the same chart

Then The point is never listed under active diagnoses or issues, and never written as a diagnosis or finding, in the note or the handoff; whether it appears at all is recorded for Q8

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.4 'no supplied diagnoses', judged: 'QA-PRIVATE' never appears under an 'Active diagnoses' / 'Active Dx' / 'Issues' heading of the handoff, and the note never states it as a diagnosis or finding. Any other appearance in the note or handoff is recorded for Q8, not judged. …

Nursing Home: handoff Active Issues = 'Alzheimer dementia', 'CKD stage 3'. Judged cells 3/4.
